app.tagline: Your PC as a home server

install.title: Set up Konak
install.intro: Konak prepares this PC to run home server apps and makes them reachable from your phone and other devices at home. You pick the apps afterwards.
install.running: Installing… you can keep using your PC.
install.admin_note: Windows will ask once for administrator permission.

network.public_title: This network is set to Public
network.public_body: Windows blocks devices at home from reaching this PC on Public networks. Switch it to Private if this is your home network.

steps.network: Make konak.local reachable on your network

reboot.title: Restart needed
reboot.body: Windows needs a restart to finish installing WSL. Konak continues on its own after you sign in again.

done.tray: Konak keeps running in the system tray when you close this window.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.uac_declined: Administrator permission was declined. Konak needs it once to set up WSL and the firewall.
errors.virtualization_off: Virtualization is turned off in this PC's firmware (BIOS/UEFI). Turn it on, then try again.
errors.invalid_name: Use 1 to 63 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
errors.name_reserved: This name is reserved for Konak's home page.
errors.name_in_use: Another app already uses this name.
errors.name_taken_on_lan: Another device on your network already uses this name.
errors.no_lan_ip: This PC is not connected to a network.
errors.busy: This app is busy with another operation. Try again when it finishes.
errors.unknown_app: This app is not in the catalog.
errors.state_unreadable: Konak's settings file (state.json in the Konak folder) is damaged, so Konak changed nothing. Restore it from a backup, or remove it and run the setup again.

home.no_apps: No apps installed yet. Install them from the Konak window on the PC.
home.cert_body: Some apps use HTTPS with Konak's own certificate. Install this certificate once on each device to trust them.
home.cert_check: Before you trust it, compare its SHA-256 fingerprint with the one shown in the Konak window on the PC. If you cannot see that window, do not install the certificate.

repair.title: Other devices may not reach Konak
repair.body: Konak's firewall rules are missing, for example after Konak was reinstalled. Without them, Windows blocks your apps for other devices or asks for permission. Repairing needs administrator permission once.

panel.empty: No apps installed yet. Use Add app to install one.

failed.install: Install failed. Konak stopped the app and kept its data, so you can try again.
failed.claim: Could not make it available on your network.

claim.notice: Create your admin account, then make it available on your network.
claim.local_only: For now only this PC can open it, at {url}. Other devices cannot reach it yet.
claim.future_name: Name on your network after setup: {name}
claim.title: Finish setup on this PC first

rename.label: Name on your network
rename.hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. The app moves to the new address.

logs.title: Logs: {name}
logs.note: Last {n} lines. Passwords and keys are hidden.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.body: The app stops and disappears from your network.
remove.keep_note: Its settings and data are kept, so installing it again brings them back.
remove.delete_warning: This permanently deletes the app's settings, accounts and database. It cannot be undone. Files in your Media and Photos folders are not touched.

cert.title: Secure connections (HTTPS)
cert.what: Some apps, like password managers, only work over a secure connection. Konak signs those connections with its own certificate, which exists only on this PC. A device trusts these apps after you install the certificate on it once.
cert.download: On the device, open this address or scan the code:
cert.fingerprint_check: The certificate is downloaded over a plain connection, so check it: before you trust it, make sure the fingerprint your device shows is exactly the one in this window. If it differs, do not install it.
cert.this_pc_body: Browsers on this PC need the certificate too. Windows asks you to confirm.
cert.trusted: The certificate is trusted on this PC.
cert.ios_1: Open the address in Safari and allow the download.
cert.ios_2: Open Settings, tap Profile Downloaded, then Install. Under More Details, compare the fingerprint with the one in the Konak window on the PC. If it differs, do not install it.
cert.ios_3: Go to Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings and turn on full trust for Konak.
cert.android_1: Open the address and download the file.
cert.android_2: Open Settings > Security > Encryption & credentials > Install a certificate > CA certificate, then pick the file. Menu names vary by phone maker.
cert.android_3: Under Trusted credentials > User > Konak, compare the fingerprint with the one in the Konak window on the PC. If it differs, remove the certificate.
cert.windows_1: Download the file and run certutil -dump on it in a terminal. Compare the Cert Hash(sha256) line with the fingerprint in the Konak window on the PC. If it differs, do not install it.
cert.windows_2: Open the file, choose Install Certificate > Current User, and place it in Trusted Root Certification Authorities.
cert.macos_1: Download the file and open it. Keychain Access adds it to the login keychain.
cert.macos_2: Open the certificate in Keychain Access and compare the SHA-256 fingerprint with the one in the Konak window on the PC. If it differs, delete it.
cert.macos_3: Expand Trust and set When using this certificate to Always Trust.

network.public: This network is set to Public, so other devices at home cannot reach your apps. Switch it to Private in Windows network settings if this is your home network.

host.title: This PC
host.subtitle: Windows 11 · WSL 2 · Konak's own Linux environment with Podman
host.no_usage: Usage shows while the engine is running.

detail.reach_pc: This PC only, until setup is done
detail.stopped_note: The app is stopped. Its settings and data are kept, and Start brings it back. Other devices cannot reach it while it is stopped.

add.title: Add an app
add.intro: Each app runs in its own containers on this PC. Pick one, check what it needs, then install. You finish its setup on this PC before other devices can reach it.
add.install_wait: Large apps can take several minutes to download.
add.name_later: You can rename it after it is installed.
add.req_memory_unknown: Konak's environment is not running, so free memory is unknown.
add.req_memory_low: Konak's environment has only {total} of memory. The app may run slowly or fail.
add.req_network_ok: Other devices at home will be able to reach it.
add.req_network_public: This network is Public, so other devices at home cannot reach it yet.
add.req_https_detail: Each device needs Konak's certificate once. See This PC.

port80.title: Port 80 is used by another program
port80.owner: {owner} is using port 80 on this PC.
port80.owner_unknown: Another program is using port 80 on this PC.
port80.body: Until it is free, Konak serves your apps on port {port}, so their addresses include it (for example http://konak.local:{port}). When port 80 is free again, Konak moves back by itself and the addresses lose the port.
port80.restart_note: Each switch restarts your apps, so they are unavailable for a few seconds.

diag_msg.distro_down: Konak's Linux environment is not running.
diag_msg.no_network: This PC is not connected to a network.

forward_policy.no_tool: The network tools this check needs are missing.
forward_policy.ok: Container traffic can pass through the shared WSL network.
forward_policy.drop: Another WSL distribution blocks container traffic in the shared network.

stale_netavark.table_missing: {containers} containers are running, but their network rules are missing.
stale_netavark.foreign: Rules left by a removed environment still take port {ports}.
stale_netavark.closed: These app ports do not answer yet: {ports}. An app may still be starting.

keepalive.no_heartbeat: Konak's background service has not run yet.
keepalive.stale: Konak's background service last reported {age} seconds ago.
keepalive.not_running: The process that keeps the environment awake is not running.

port80_owner.net_error: The network check could not be read.
port80_owner.fallback: {owner} holds port 80, so Konak uses port {port} for now.
port80_owner.taken: {owner} holds port 80, so Konak's web server cannot start.
port80_owner.returning: Port 80 is free again. Konak moves back to it within about two minutes.
port80_owner.ok: Konak's web server answers on port 80.

lan_adapter.virtual: The connection in use is a virtual adapter ({adapter}), so other devices may not reach this PC.
lan_adapter.ip_changed: This PC's network address changed. Konak is switching to the new one.

diag_fix.distro_down: Start Konak from the tray icon, then run the diagnostics again.
diag_fix.no_network: Connect this PC to your home network.

forward_policy.no_tool: Run Konak's setup again to reinstall the container engine.
forward_policy.drop: Docker in another WSL distribution changed this. Stop that Docker, then restart your apps in Konak.

stale_netavark.table_missing: Wait a minute and run the diagnostics again. If it stays, the technical details show how to repair it.
stale_netavark.foreign: Wait a minute and run the diagnostics again. If it stays, the technical details show how to repair it.
stale_netavark.closed: Wait a minute and run the diagnostics again. If it stays, the technical details show how to repair it.

keepalive.no_heartbeat: Quit Konak from the tray icon and start it again.
keepalive.stale: Quit Konak from the tray icon and start it again.
keepalive.not_running: Quit Konak from the tray icon and start it again.

port80_owner.fallback: Stop or reconfigure that program to free port 80. Konak then moves back by itself.
port80_owner.taken: Stop or reconfigure that program to free port 80. Konak then starts its web server within seconds.
port80_owner.nothing: Quit Konak from the tray icon and start it again.

lan_adapter.virtual: Turn off the VPN or virtual network that holds the connection.
lan_adapter.ip_changed: Wait a few seconds. If it stays, restart Konak.

mcp.intro: An AI agent asks Konak to do this through its MCP connection.

effect.install: Konak downloads {app} and starts it. Only this PC can open it until you finish its setup.
effect.remove: {app} stops and disappears from your network. Its settings and data are kept.
effect.remove_delete: {app} is removed and its data is deleted for good: settings, accounts and database. This cannot be undone.
effect.stop: {app} stops. Nobody can use it until it is started again. Its data is kept.
effect.restart: {app} restarts and is unavailable for a short time.
effect.rename: {app} moves to the new address {name}.local. Bookmarks and phone apps that use the old address stop working.
effect.claim: {app} becomes reachable from every device on your home network. Do this only after you have created its admin account.

mcp.check: Approve only if you asked an AI agent for this.
